method: Production Canvas2D renderer, native Skia; exact source path, uniform scale, facing, anchor and static reuse checked.
limitations: A repeated stance is one authored base, not nine action drawings or frame-by-frame animation.
Native Canvas does not exercise DOM, input, audio, service workers or a physical device.
Technical rendering checks do not certify canonical 1:1 identity or hidden anatomy.
scope: The fourteen recovered continuation A base families and eighteen continuation B Queenie families, 32 appearances in total.
collection: Thirty-two sequential Node workers; each worker has a 128 MiB JavaScript heap limit and releases its native image state before the next.

visualReview.note: Technical checks do not establish visual or canonical fidelity. Open all individual sheets and record observations separately.

resume.reason: The initial sequential capture stopped on ENOSPC while writing the twenty-ninth family. Completed families were retained only after current source and native-asset SHA256 verification; all sheets were decoded again for the overview.
